raise_justifications.desktop/macos/Desktop/Sources/Chat/Agent: Carries the agent-runtime payload failure across the bridge as a typed BridgeError.agentRuntimePayloadIncomplete(missing:) rather than letting an incomplete install reach the user as the raw string "pi-mono process exited (code 1)". The error must be raised where the bridge already owns runtime failure classification; a separate type would give the same failure two owners.

Refuses to start when the bundled runtime payload is incomplete, extending the existing "pi-mono start refused, …" preconditions this file already owns. A build that shipped without Contents/Resources/pi-mono-extension accepted every turn and died four seconds later; the check belongs beside the other start-refusal reasons, not in a new observer.
